searchText: Hi, here are some questions about verkle tree proof, I read `gballet/go-verkle` code. my question is: why proof return so many fileds? what they means? only proof useful? `proof, cis, zis, yis, _ := MakeVerkleMultiProof(root, [][]byte{ffx32KeyTest})` I also found a `SerializeProof(proof *Proof) (*VerkleProof, StateDiff, error)`, what they means? the stateDiff used to recover state? see code here: https://github.com/gballet/go-verkle/blob/master/proof_test.go#L44 https://github.com/gballet/go-verkle/blob/master/proof_ipa.go#L151 For the first question, these are the elements needed to construct the proof, as described in this document: https://dankradfeist.de/ethereum/2021/06/18/pcs-multiproofs.html For the second question, state diff tracks the difference in the state before and after the execution of the block. It is described here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/509fbb2c5ca74d93e9d0c3b3532be4c7214e1cd5/specs/_features/verge/beacon-chain.md Thank you, one more question: here is a sparse verkle tree, max level is 7, I found the deeper level has larger proof size? I only count serialized proof size. The proof will change in diff level? may 32 byte every level? yes, the proofs get larger as the tree gets deeper as adding one level means adding a new C, yi and zi for each level. Thanks your patient reply~ <@353136597522448385>

excerpts.author: build4c
excerpts.content:
Hi, here are some questions about verkle tree proof, I read `gballet/go-verkle` code.

my question is: why proof return so many fileds?  what they means? only proof useful?
`proof, cis, zis, yis, _ := MakeVerkleMultiProof(root, [][]byte{ffx32KeyTest})`

I also found a `SerializeProof(proof *Proof) (*VerkleProof, StateDiff, error)`, what they means?  the stateDiff used to recover state?

see code here: https://github.com/gballet/go-verkle/blob/master/proof_test.go#L44

https://github.com/gballet/go-verkle/blob/master/proof_ipa.go#L151

excerpts.author: gballet
excerpts.content:
For the first question, these are the elements needed to construct the proof, as described in this document: https://dankradfeist.de/ethereum/2021/06/18/pcs-multiproofs.html

For the second question, state diff tracks the difference in the state before and after the execution of the block. It is described here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/509fbb2c5ca74d93e9d0c3b3532be4c7214e1cd5/specs/_features/verge/beacon-chain.md

excerpts.author: build4c
excerpts.content:
Thank you, one more question:
here is a sparse verkle tree, max level is 7, I found the deeper level has larger proof size? I only count serialized proof size. The proof will change in diff level? may 32 byte every level?

excerpts.author: gballet
excerpts.content: yes, the proofs get larger as the tree gets deeper as adding one level means adding a new C, yi and zi for each level.
